form.oneLiner: Australia's mobile-first bank built for people who actually live on their phones.
form.realStory: We started Up because banking in Australia felt like it was built for a generation that still wrote cheques. So we built Up inside Bendigo's licence — a real bank, designed phone-first from the ground up. Instant notifications. Savers you can name. Pay-day automation that splits your money before you can spend it.
form.customers: Australians 18-34 who want their bank to feel like a product, not a utility — early-career professionals, freelancers, couples managing shared savings goals.
form.proof: 700,000+ customers in 5 years with zero paid acquisition in year one. NPS in the 70s. Maybi shared accounts hit 100k users in 6 months. Backed by Bendigo & Adelaide Bank ADI licence.

brandWorld.brandPersonality: Unapologetically bright, phone-native Australian bank that treats money as something you feel, not fear
brandWorld.visualDirection: A coral-and-yellow workspace that feels like the Up app itself — bold saturated surfaces, black card tiles, and tight geometric type that makes financial data feel alive rather than austere. No bank blues, no suit-and-tie restraint; every surface earns its colour.
avoid: Navy/dark blue as the dominant surface — this brand is coral, not conservative
Glassmorphism or frosted panels — the brand is opaque and confident
Generic AI sparkle or abstract fintech glow blobs
Serif typography — Up is geometric, rounded, anti-establishment
Pale grey enterprise SaaS aesthetic — wrong register entirely
Muted pastel softening of the coral and yellow — keep them saturated
brandWorld.whyThisWorks: Up's entire identity is built on the coral-yellow-black trio — the website body is coral, the cards are black, and yellow does the punchy CTA work. Mirroring that exact hierarchy in the deck makes every slide feel like a native screen from the app, which is exactly the product promise.
motifs: Rounded black card tiles on coral surface — mirrors the Up app's home screen
Yellow pill badges for transaction categories and CTAs
Pink (#ff8bd1) as decorative ink for icons and illustration strokes
Tight numeric stat displays in Space Mono for balances and growth figures
Coral-to-dark gradient edge treatment on hero sections only
brandWorld.backgroundSystem: Flat coral surface, no gradient blobs — black card tiles sit directly on coral with 24px radius and no stroke
brandWorld.deckTheme: Bold coral-and-black consumer fintech deck — saturated surfaces, yellow punches, black tile cards, and DM Sans set heavy; feels like the Up app opened full-screen
